assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: corrective action following root cause analysis at PSV-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-4110 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. PSV-4110 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 18 June 2011 a corrective action on PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the critical safeguard it was raised to restore.
